extension.summary: Apple TV+ and iTunes client for Kodi (experimental)
extension.description:
Sign in with your Apple ID and browse Apple TV+ originals and your iTunes movie library, playing back through InputStream Adaptive with Widevine DRM.
EXPERIMENTAL: Apple provides no public API. This addon mimics the Apple TV web/Android client to receive Widevine-protected streams (the only DRM Kodi can decrypt). Because Kodi only ships the software Widevine L3 CDM, playback quality is limited to standard definition; HD/4K require the hardware DRM found only on Apple devices. Apple ID sign-in, 2FA and the playback endpoints depend on Apple's private, undocumented services and may need updating whenever Apple changes them.
Features: * Apple ID sign-in with two-factor authentication * Browse Apple TV+ Originals (shows and movies) * Browse your iTunes purchased/rented movie library * Search the Apple TV catalogue * Widevine playback via InputStream Adaptive
extension.disclaimer: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple Inc. Apple, Apple TV and iTunes are trademarks of Apple Inc. Use with your own account and content only.
extension.news:
2026.7.31 - Encrypted playback working - Playback now works on Kodi 22 with InputStream Adaptive 22, using the new inputstream.adaptive.drm property (secure_decoder, pre_init_data). - Streams are limited to the lowest quality tier (360p by default), H.264 and SDR: Apple keys each tier separately and the CDM reports the higher tiers' keys as output restricted, cannot decode HEVC, and Kodi renders Dolby Vision with shifted colours. - Key ids are supplied to ISA via KEYID and the init segment's tenc box, which Apple leaves empty. - Sporting events report clearly instead of failing with a 404.
2026.7.30 - Experimental release (matched to real web client) - NEW: Apple ID sign-in rebuilt from a real tv.apple.com capture: authorize -> SRP init/complete with X-Apple-HC hashcash -> two-factor (trusted-device or SMS) -> session trust. Real OAuth client id. - NEW: Catalogue via confirmed UTS endpoints (Apple TV+ Originals channel canvas, search) with tokens scraped from the web shell. - NEW: Widevine playback pipeline: HLS via InputStream Adaptive with a local licence proxy that wraps the challenge in Apple's fpsRequest JSON envelope (Apple serves Widevine to non-Apple clients). - NOTE: Two playback tokens (account media-user-token and the per-title playback token) are still being reproduced; advanced settings accept pasted values to test playback meanwhile. SD only (Widevine L3).
